title: THE JUDGMENT BY WEIRWOOD // ASH AND BONE
narrative: The King's Men drag Theon before Stannis inside the drafty watchtower. The Karstark plotters hang from pine branches outside. Lord Arnolf Karstark sits in chains, and the Northerners scream for Theon's blood to pay for Bran and Rickon Stark. Stannis looks at Theon's broken mouth and missing toes. 'A headman's sword is clean; a burning is noisy. You slew the Ned's sons, Greyjoy. The old gods demand your life beneath the weirwood.'
resolvesPlotHole: Theon's Fate at the Crofter's Village

options.text: March Theon to the weirwood heart tree on the frozen islet.
Keep Theon alive as a tactical hostage to claim the Iron Islands.
Listen to Mormont's raven scream on the sill: 'CORN! SUBSCRIBE TO THE WEIRWOOD PODCAST!'
